BETWEEN:-
 SUNEEL KUMAR S/O SHRI RAMCHARAN JATAV, AGED  22 YEARS, OCCUPATION- STUDY, R/O GRAM  AHARWANPUR POLICE STATION MAYAPUR TEHSIL  KHANIYADHANA, DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MUKESH KUMAR- ADVOCATE )

AND  STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION KHANIYADHANA, DISTRICT SHIVPURI  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI A.P.S. TOMAR- GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER Case Diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
The petitioner has filed this first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

T h e applicant has been arrested on 21.04.2023 by Police Station Khaniyadana, District Shivpuri (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.220/2023, registered in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC.
According to the prosecution story, Police Station Khaniyadhana has registered a case against the applicant vide Crime No.220/2023 on the basis of absolutely false report of the complainant.

By registering a wrong case, the applicant was present before the Court of JMFC, Khaniyadhana,

sentences.text: District Shivpuri, MP on 22.04.2023 from where the applicant was sent to judicial custody by the Court of JMFC, Khaniyadhana, District Shivpuri, MP.

The applicant is a student studying in B.Sc.
degree, whose exam time is near, if he is kept in jail, then he will be deprived of continuous study and will also face difficulties in giving his exam, which will definitely affect his future.

According to the written application of the complainant and the First Information Report, it has been told by the complainant that physical relations have been made between the applicant and her on her free will.

In this case, the complainant is 25 years of age and is a major, in such a situation,
the complainant has been in a relationship voluntarily, therefore, this is no basis for registering an FIR for the crime under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection by contending that on the basis of the allegations and the material available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.
After hearing Counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs.
One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties each to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.
This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the petitioner :-
1. The petitioner will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
2. The petitioner will cooperate in the investigation/trial, as the case may be;
3.
A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for compliance.
